cover-purple.headline: Your fundraising,
cover-purple.subtitle: A custom platform overview for Tiffany Brodie and the team at The Well Summit — capabilities, onboarding, and investment details for your evaluation and Lily Foundation grant proposal.

your-moment.title: You're building something
your-moment.subtitle: The Well Summit is at a pivotal point — strategic plan complete, Lily Foundation grant in progress, and a 5-year growth roadmap ready to execute. Getting the right infrastructure in place now is what makes the next chapter possible.

items.heading: Strategic clarity, operational gap
items.body: The StratOP process is done. Goals are set. What's missing is the system to run it — donor data is scattered, giving platforms are disconnected, stewardship happens by memory.

items.heading: Funding opportunity in front of you
items.body: The Lily Foundation grant requires naming a technology vendor. Choosing DonorDock now supports the grant narrative and positions The Well Summit for funded capacity-building.

items.heading: Growth that honors your mission
items.body: Scaling access without scaling complexity requires tools that work harder in the background, so your team stays focused on people and ministry.

what_you_need.title: What you need from a platform
items: One place for every donor, supporter, and camper
Giving pages that replace Givebutter and ThriveCart
A pipeline to track grants, major gifts, and sponsors
Email and text connected to your CRM data
Automations that handle follow-up you'd otherwise miss
A migration team that moves your current data for you
A partner, not just a vendor

quote.text: If we run the nonprofit more like a business and instill streamlined efficiencies, we'll have the capacity to offer additional program events to expand access — but still keep it intimate.
quote.attribution: Tiffany Brodie, COO, The Well Summit

tool-consolidation.title: One platform
tool-consolidation.subtitle: Your fundraising infrastructure is spread across disconnected tools. Data doesn't flow. Every supporter requires manual work in multiple places. DonorDock consolidates all of it.

items.name: Givebutter
items.body: Online donations — data stays in Givebutter, not connected to a CRM or donor record.

items.name: ThriveCart
items.body: Camper community investment plans — a workaround, not connected to donor stewardship.

items.name: Email Tool
items.body: Outreach goes out, but engagement data doesn't connect to giving or attendance records.

items.name: No CRM
items.body: No single record of who your donors, camper supporters, and participants actually are.

callout.title: The cost of fragmentation
callout.body: Manual re-entry. No holistic donor view. Cultivation by memory. Grant reporting requires piecing data from multiple sources.

items.name: Giving Pages (replaces Givebutter)
items.body: Branded giving pages embedded on your website. All gifts flow directly into your donor records.

items.name: Camper Support Pages (replaces ThriveCart)
items.body: Unlimited individual pages with goals, tracking, and text-to-donate. Each gift tied to the specific camper.

items.name: Email + Text (replaces email tool)
items.body: Drag-and-drop email and two-way SMS built into the platform. Every open and click tracked on the contact record.

items.name: Donor CRM (new capability)
items.body: One complete profile per contact: giving history, attendance, engagement, notes, custom badges — all in one place.

callout.title: The value of integration
callout.body: Every gift, email, event, and camper sponsorship tracked to one record. Segment, report, and steward from one view.

onboarding-3phase.title: Switching platforms
onboarding-3phase.subtitle: DonorDock includes white glove data migration and a 90-day structured onboarding program with every subscription. You get a dedicated team — not a help doc and a wish.

phases.label: Phase 1 · Days 1–30
phases.name: Setup
phases.body: Your dedicated data migration specialist maps and imports everything — contacts from Givebutter, gift history, activities, campaign records. Email domain authenticated. Platform configured.
phases.closing: You don't touch the technical work. We handle it.
phases.result: Your data is in DonorDock — clean, validated, ready.

phases.label: Phase 2 · Days 31–60
phases.name: Activation
phases.body: Your Customer Success Manager works with your team on training and adoption. Your top two workflows — a new donor journey and camper giving pages — are built and activated together.
phases.closing: Your team is using DonorDock with confidence.
phases.result: Team live and running key workflows.

phases.label: Phase 3 · Days 61–90
phases.name: Growth
phases.body: Early results reviewed. Additional automations configured. Otto set up for your portfolio. Leadership dashboards activated. You receive a written 90-day growth plan for what to tackle next.

narrative.title: Built from day one for nonprofits
paragraphs: DonorDock was founded in 2017 by two Microsoft engineers who wanted to build something genuinely useful for nonprofits in their community — not an enterprise CRM with a nonprofit skin, but a platform purpose-built for how fundraising teams actually work.
Everything in DonorDock was built by our team from the ground up. No acquired tools taped together. That's why the platform feels coherent — because it is.

next-steps-numbered.title: Ready when

steps.heading: Share this with your team
steps.body: Review the platform overview and investment summary with your leadership team and board. Your husband's familiarity with HubSpot will help frame the comparison — DonorDock is the same architecture, built for nonprofit fundraising rather than B2B sales. Same mental model. Better fit for your work.

steps.heading: Name DonorDock in your Lily Foundation proposal
steps.body: This document provides the platform overview, pricing, and organizational rationale you need for your grant narrative. If you need a letter of intent, additional technical specifications, or any supporting materials for the application, reach out — we're glad to support it directly.

steps.heading: Come back when you're ready to move
steps.body: No pressure to engage before funding is in place. When the grant comes through, DonorDock will be ready. We're rated #1 Easiest Setup on G2 — most teams are fully live in days, not months. Your 90-day onboarding program means you'll have a dedicated team from day one.
